system.description:
Prerequisite: Transform Genjutsu

When you cast Transform you can transform into small, medium or large objects. When you transform into a large object your weight does not change and you still only occupy your normal Space and you only look like you occupy a larger space. An Investigation or Illusion check vs your Genjutsu save DC will reveal it’s a disguise. When you transform into a smaller object you can occupy smaller spaces while transformed but you cannot move from the place you transformed from, instead another creature who can lift your normal weight can move you if you are willing.
